title: Wacky/ out of control dreams
content: Has anyone here been getting lockdown dreams lately? About 2 nights ago, I was inside a mall when all of a sudden I saw a group of people in weird "hazmat" suits trying to close the place down in order to prevent us from leaving the mall. Luckily I escaped from it. In other dreams I had, I dealt with AI security bots and black drone/ airplane hybrids. I don't know why I am having those dreams. Sometimes I feel like I am being watched in my dreams. There is an element of my dreams that is out of my control. Most of my dreams really don't make sense at all. It has gotten to a point that I somehow teleported to the place I was sleeping in real life and somehow I ended up seeing a toy version of Mario (who looked more like a zombie with a gaping mouth) holding a pistol and besides him was a toy version of a Halo/ COD robot holding a shotgun pointing at me while I was being stuck paralyzed in my reclining chair that I usually sleep in. The strangest thing about the toy figures is that they look like they come out of an AI drawing app. This happened about a night ago. About 3 days ago, I was walking around a campus and somehow I was carrying Daffy Duck's beak and somehow it was able to speak. I am not even a looney tunes fan nor a COD fan to even come up with those dreams. Like I said, most of the dreams I have are extremely random and wacky to the point that I either wake up laughing at how ridiculous my dreams are or I just wake up with apathy. My dreams always turn out to be extreme in anything in one shape or form.
